examples.trans: This sheep died of old age.

examples.text: Скажи честно, этот баран умер от старости?

examples.trans: I already have enough sheep in the kitchen.

examples.text: Настоящий повар чувствует каждый вкус блюда.
examples.trans: A real chef feels every taste of the dish.

examples.text: Осталось ровно три минуты до готовности блюда.
examples.trans: Exactly three minutes remain until the dish is ready.
The chef prepared a delicious dish.

meanings.note: the present tense is normally left out: я мэр = I am the mayor
Present есть; у меня есть = I have.

examples.trans: I have a toy car.
Childhood was hard.
You will be asking for forgiveness.
How is it in Hungary?
I grew up in a communal flat.

It's an important question.
I have important business.

examples.text: Я тебе утром говорил: не торопись. Это очень важный вопрос.
examples.trans: I told you this morning: don't rush. It's a very important question.
Everything's fine.
As you all know...
Share with everyone.

examples.text: Я впервые в жизни вижу такое.
examples.trans: I see such a thing for the first time in my life.

examples.text: Но с ним я впервые в жизни счастлива.
examples.trans: But with him I am happy for the first time in my life.
The chef praised the young cook for the first time.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.trans: As you all know...
Does the governor support you?

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: emphatic at the start of a sentence

examples.trans: Oh yeah?
Yes, it's me.
Oh yeah? When?

meanings.note: + dative of person + accusative of thing
imperative давай/давайте + 1st person plural or infinitive

examples.trans: Let's talk.
He gives me a book.

examples.text: Давай мы его уволим, а тебя на его место назначим.
examples.trans: Let's fire him and put you in his place.

related.gloss: to hand in; to take (an exam)

meanings.note: collective number for people and children, + genitive plural: двое детей

examples.trans: A wife, two kids.
Well, yes. A wife, two kids.

examples.text: А у меня все шансы есть. Жена, двое детей, не сидел, служил в армии.
examples.trans: And I've got every chance. A wife, two kids, no prison record, I served in the army.

meanings.note: на днях = in the next few days, or the other day

examples.trans: Good afternoon!
I'll call in the next few days.
Any day now, on the website.
We could open a salon for you.
This is for you.

examples.text: Для вас можно открыть салон красоты.
examples.trans: We could open a beauty salon for you.
Maybe we should order?
We ordered tea and sandwiches.

examples.text: Если опоздают, пицца бесплатно. Может, закажем?
examples.trans: If they're late, the pizza is free. Maybe we should order?
Sorry, I'm in a hurry.
Sorry, I didn't mean to offend you.

examples.text: Аркадий Борисович, извините, тут к вам человек.
examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich, excuse me, there's someone here to see you.
There are only the freshest ingredients there.
All ingredients are ready.

examples.text: Скажите хотя бы один секретный ингредиент.
examples.trans: Tell me at least one secret ingredient.

meanings.note: joins a description to a noun; agrees with that noun in gender and number

examples.trans: This is a mayor who keeps his word.
Where is the book that was here?

examples.text: Это секрет, который умрёт вместе со мной.
examples.trans: It's a secret that will die with me.
Who are your rivals?
Who's there?
Arkady Borisovich, who are your rivals?

meanings.note: кого + instrumental: назвать меня плохим словом

examples.trans: You called me a bad word.
What will you name your son?

examples.text: Ты назвал меня плохим словом. Меня, начальника!
examples.trans: You called me a bad word. Me, your boss!
We started to worry.
Let's begin!

examples.text: Это хорошо, что готово. А то мы уже начали беспокоиться.
examples.trans: It's good that it's ready. We were starting to worry.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: I don't know.
There wasn't enough money.
Chef, I didn't take it.

meanings.note: + genitive: 'у нас нет выбора' = we have no choice

examples.trans: No, it's mine.

examples.trans: Yesterday I really screwed up badly in front of Vika.

examples.text: Только попробуй облажаться на глазах у ресторанного критика!
examples.trans: Just try messing up in front of the restaurant critic!
They are building a centre.
History will punish them.

examples.text: Ты преподавай. А они пусть строят свои торговые центры.
examples.trans: You teach. And let them build their shopping centres.
I love our town very much.
It's very hard.

examples.text: Я очень люблю наш город. Поэтому я иду на второй срок.
examples.trans: I love our town very much. That's why I'm running for a second term.

meanings.note: С первого раза = the first time.

examples.trans: This is my first day.

examples.text: Ты не понимаешь с первого раза?
examples.trans: You don't understand the first time?

examples.text: Ты что, с первого раза не понимаешь?
examples.trans: What, you don't understand the first time?
Bye!
Bye, Dad!
Bye, darling!

meanings.en: to put, to place, to lay down

examples.text: В гроб с собой икру не положишь!
examples.trans: You can't put caviar in your coffin to take with you!
Put the keys on the table.

examples.text: А вот сюда я её и положу! Отличный подарок будет!
examples.trans: Right here is where I will put it! It will be an excellent gift!

meanings.en: to please, to be to someone's liking
meanings.note: + dative: тебе понравится = you'll like it

examples.trans: Don't be afraid, you'll like it.
I really liked this film.

examples.text: А придётся! Не бойся, тебе понравится.
examples.trans: Well, you'll have to! Don't be afraid, you'll like it.
Why are we going so slowly?
Why are you here?

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

придумать.gloss: to think up, to come up with

meanings.en: to think up, to invent, to come up with

examples.trans: You came up with this yourself!
I'll think up a plan.

examples.text: Как нет? Ты же сам это всё придумал!
examples.trans: What do you mean, no time? You came up with all this yourself!

examples.text: А я вот вам чаю с сушками принёс.
examples.trans: I've brought you some tea and bread rings.
Bring some water, please.
What did you bring into the flat?

meanings.en: to drag in, to bring (something heavy or unwanted)

examples.text: Это Федя всё придумал, барана притащил.
examples.trans: It was all Fedya's idea, he dragged the ram in.
Why did you drag the dog in here?
I'm just tired.
It's easy.

examples.text: Мы просто не хотели вас беспокоить. Всё отменим!
examples.trans: We just didn't want to bother you. We'll cancel it all!

meanings.note: refers back to the subject: 'он держит своё слово' = he keeps his word

examples.trans: He keeps his word.
They are building their houses.

examples.text: А что я за мэр такой, который держит своё слово?
examples.trans: And what kind of mayor would I be if I kept my word?

This is an item made by a master's hands.

examples.text: Это блюдо сделано по всем правилам.
examples.trans: This dish is made according to all rules.

I'll do it tomorrow.

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо сделать ещё больше.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need to do even more.

examples.text: У нас есть большая тарелка рыбы и крабов.
examples.trans: We have a big platter of fish and crabs.
Put clean plates on the table.

examples.text: Успокойтесь, я ещё сделаю! Куда ставить тарелку?
examples.trans: Calm down, I'll make more! Where should I put the plate?
Well, what you were saying.

examples.text: Если проблема только в этом, то да.
examples.trans: If that's the only problem, then yes.

examples.text: А то мы уже начали беспокоиться.
examples.trans: Otherwise we were already starting to worry.

meanings.note: softens a request: только не сердись = just don't be angry

examples.trans: I was only looking.
Just one.
I was only looking!

Have you got any more?

He's at our place.

examples.trans: Hi! Look what I've got.
Good!
Everything's fine.

Say something.

examples.text: Правда, Нин, всё нормально. Скажи что-нибудь, пожалуйста.
examples.trans: Honestly, Nina, everything's fine. Say something, please.

meanings.note: pointing at a thing or a situation; 'это' + noun = 'this is ...'
points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: That's mine.
And this is for you.
And this is for you. A toy car!

meanings.note: alone: 'я этого не хочу' = I don't want that

examples.trans: This house.
I'm sick of this communal flat.

examples.text: Меня уже тошнит от этой коммуналки! У нас труба уже неделю течёт.
examples.trans: I'm sick of this communal flat! Our pipe has been leaking for a week now.

meanings.en: other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: I'm doing my homework.
I grew up here.
